title: FailedEventsToDbFailedEventsStore
description: A record in the DynamoDB failed_jobs table, the permanent failure log written only by job-failed, one per failure. It has no TTL. Summary text, invocation payloads and raw error messages are never stored here.

id.description: The table's key: the job ID, or for setup-project, which has no job, the asynchronous invocation's request ID. Rows are created only if the key is new, so each failure is handled once.

sender.description: The Lambda that reported the failure or whose invocation failed.

reason.description: A short code without whitespace: a worker's error code (e.g. github_forbidden), <condition>:<errorType> for a failed invocation (e.g. RetriesExhausted:GitHubUnavailable), or stale_<status>.

channel_id.description: The Slack channel the failure message is for.

thread_ts.description: The thread the failure message is for, only if known; otherwise absent or null.

failed_at.description: Unix seconds when job-failed logged the failure.

message_sent.description: False when the row is created; true once Slack accepts the failure message. A failed post leaves it false and is not retried.
